EWITY.TOKEN_HINT: Paste your Ewity API token. It is encrypted and stored securely.
EWITY.TOKEN_GUIDE_LINK: How do I get an API token?
EWITY.TOKEN_GUIDE_STEPS:
1. Login to Ewity
2. Go to Admin > Users
3. Open "Create New User"
4. Enter details as you prefer, e.g. Full Name: API User, Username: apiuser, Email: leave blank if allowed, Password: any random password
5. Once the user is created, open their details page, click the ⋯ menu, and choose "Convert To API User"
6. An API Tokens section will appear — click "Create New Token" and paste it here
EWITY.TEST_REQUIRES_SAVE: Save the connector with your API token to enable testing.
EWITY.PERM_SEARCH_PRODUCTS: Search products — answer questions about stock and pricing
EWITY.PERM_GET_PRODUCT: Get product details — answer questions about a specific product's description
EWITY.TEST_PERMISSION_DENIED: Permission denied — grant access in Ewity.
EWITY.TEST_INVALID_TOKEN: Invalid token — check the token and try again
EWITY.TEST_UNREACHABLE: Could not reach Ewity — check your connection
EWITY.PERMISSION_GUIDE_STEPS:
1. Login to Ewity
2. Go to Admin > Users
3. Click the ⋯ menu (top right) and choose "Manage Permission Levels"
4. Find the "API / API User" permission level and click "Details"
5. Under the "Product" section, find "Read Products" and tick "Include In Level"
6. Scroll to the bottom and click "Update Permission Level"
7. Click Test again to confirm it works
